findings.title: Hidden fault triggers a substitute witness
findings.claim: When the first pair is found liable, 5:107 presents the next pair as recognized claimants who take over the first pair's place, and their testimony answers the earlier account with a claim to greater rightfulness.
findings.mechanism: The focus discovery form is joined to the liability phrase, the repeated right-and-entitlement forms contact the priority of the affected side and the comparison of testimonies, and the standing-in construction makes replacement a change of procedural office rather than mere presence. The focus branch imagery for stumbling upon evidence and a trap adds a bounded discovery-pressure to the same local sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The conditional becomes a visible procedural hinge: concealed wrongdoing is exposed, the entitled side enters the vacant position, and the new oath can redirect authority without erasing the ordinary legal scene.
findings.containment: This is a focus-anchored pericope reading, not a whole-surah channel claim. The stumbling and trap images remain contextual analogies around the supplied discovery form; they do not assert a physical fall or a literal trap. The unlanded returning, face, and right-hand-oath nominations are excluded.

findings.title: Denial within a disclosed legal boundary
findings.claim: The counter-witnesses' denial that they transgressed also asserts that their replacement office and stronger claim stayed within the procedural boundary assigned to them.
findings.mechanism: The supplied prohibition and permission poles in 5:87, followed by transgression after a disclosed test in 5:94, contact the focus phrase وَمَا ٱعْتَدَيْنَا. The focus denial therefore carries a bounded claim of non-overreach alongside its ordinary denial of wrongdoing.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing denial protects both moral integrity and jurisdictional scope: the new witnesses claim that they corrected the procedure without taking more authority than the procedure gave them.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains a denial of transgression. The procedural-scope nuance is an attributed contextual activation from the legacy HFT trace; it does not decide that the phrase has only a jurisdictional meaning.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT coordinates and focus return are supplied, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound and the two contextual branch records have no independent lexicon descriptors.

findings.title: An oath that can be answered
findings.claim: The focus oath functions as a regulated and answerable evidentiary instrument: after the first account fails, the new pair's oath can carry the procedure forward rather than merely seal its assertion.
findings.mechanism: 5:89 distinguishes empty oath speech from oaths deliberately bound and preserved, while 5:108 explicitly places one set of oaths after another. The focus يُقْسِمَانِ therefore contacts a prior binding-and-preservation regime and changes from a one-way solemn statement into a challengeable procedural act.
findings.reader_payoff: The oath becomes part of a repair mechanism. It binds the speakers, but its place after another oath leaves room for the evidence process to answer and redirect the first account.
findings.containment: The focus remains an oath by the replacement pair. The answerable-burden reading is attributed contextual evidence; the packet also leaves open that the oath may function only as solemn corroboration without a literal transfer of burden.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact anchors in 5:89, 5:107, and 5:108, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound and its broader burden-transfer inference remains qualified.

findings.title: The replacement pair as an answering equivalent
findings.claim: The second pair can be understood as an answering equivalent that restores procedural balance after the first pair has distorted a right, so replacement does more than simply remove unreliable speakers.
findings.mechanism: The supplied 5:95 procedure joins substitution, equivalence, adjudication, and two just assessors; 5:106 repeats the matched pair in testimony; and 5:107 supplies a pair standing in the first pair's place. Those contacts transfer the structure of measured redress into evidentiary repair and return through the focus standing-in words.
findings.reader_payoff: The second pair acquires a positive procedural role: it answers a damaged account with a measured counterpart, making the correction look like restored balance rather than an unexplained replacement.
findings.containment: The focus still says that another pair stands in the first pair's place. The equivalence mechanism is attributed contextual evidence, and the packet keeps alive the possibility that the repeated pair formula is formal parallelism without a shared compensatory mechanism.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has complete exact anchors and a focus return, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound and its transfer from material liability to evidentiary repair is an attributed inference.

findings.title: A concealed trace becomes a correction path
findings.claim: The focus discovery can be read as the surfacing of a concealed trace that is then oriented into proper testimony and used to reject or correct the defective sworn account.
findings.mechanism: 5:99 supplies the visible and concealed poles, 5:106 places concealment inside the witness procedure, and 5:108 joins testimony on its proper face to the possibility that oaths are returned. The focus عُثِرَ and شَهَادَة forms provide the return surface, turning the discovery into an error-correcting path rather than a bare trigger for replacement.
findings.reader_payoff: The clause acquires a visible before-and-after: what was hidden surfaces, the testimony is brought to the matter's proper face, and a defective oath can be sent back through the procedure.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains discovery followed by substitute witnesses. The hidden-to-visible pipeline is an attributed contextual inference; the packet also leaves open that proper face describes accurate performance only, without implying recovery of concealed evidence.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has complete exact anchors and returns through supplied focus words, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound and the pipeline is an attributed contextual synthesis.
